js: window.__undoGeom = () => { const u = document.querySelector('.toolbar [data-ev="ctx_undo"]'); if (!u) return {undo: false}; const r = u.getBoundingClientRect(); const row = document.querySelector('.toolbar').getBoundingClientRect(); const others = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar .tool-button')).filter(b => b !== u).map(b => b.getBoundingClientRect()).sort((a, b) => a.left - b.left); const rightmost = others.every(o => o.right <= r.left + 0.5); const atEdge = Math.abs(r.right - row.right) < 1; const gap = Math.round(r.left - Math.max(...others.map(o => o.right))); let grouped = 1e9; for (let i = 1; i < others.length; i++) grouped = Math.min(grouped, others[i].left - others[i - 1].right); grouped = Math.round(grouped); return {undo: true, rightmost, atEdge, gap, grouped, apart: rightmost && atEdge && gap > grouped, right: Math.round(r.right), rowRight: Math.round(row.right)}; }; return true
